text:
mike_support: FYI — PraxisHealth trial stuck at SSO step, getting 403 after IdP redirect. Trial day 10, activation blocked. Escalating to @tara_cs for priority handoff. Ticket: https://zendesk.example/agent/tickets/8921 :warning:

tara_cs: thanks. do we have logs and the account id? how likely they churn without a quick fix?

mike_support: account id: PRX-8817. logs show `POST /sso/callback 403` and `audit: invalid_signature` from our IdP parser. minimal log: ```[2026-03-12T14:22:31Z] SSO callback - user_email=admin@praxis.health status=403 reason=invalid_signature idp=okta```

sara_se: @mike_support can you confirm the IdP metadata on file? Okta sometimes rotates certs and breaks the thumbprint.

mike_support: customer says they rotated certs yesterday and sent new metadata XML to support, but our provisioning still uses old thumbprint.

jon_engineering: we can temporarily accept both certs for PRX-8817, but need CS signoff to change prod SSO policy. low-risk if limited to single tenant.

tara_cs: let's do temp bypass + comms. draft comms plan below — quick review + signoff please.

```
COMMS PLAN (rapid response)
- 0-30m: Acknowledge to customer (support -> customer): "We see the SSO problem; applying a temporary certificate acceptance. ETA 30m."
- 30-90m: Apply tenant override (eng) — enable dual-cert for PRX-8817.
- 90-120m: Confirm login with customer, collect canonical metadata, update tenant config.
- 24h: Follow-up email summarizing root cause and permanent fix timeline; ask about renewal intent. Owner: tara_cs

Message template to send now:
Hi {Name}, we applied a temporary SSO fix so you can continue evaluation. We'll complete the final config within 24 hours and follow up with details. — Tara, Customer Success
```

jon_engineering: I can push the override now. need explicit ok from CS to proceed.

tara_cs: approved. proceed now. I'll send the ack and schedule a 20m check-in for 11:00 PT. @mike_support please update the ticket with the comms text and note renewal watch.

mike_support: ack, message sent to customer (copied in ticket). updating notes now. :thumbsup:

onboard-bot: Change applied to tenant PRX-8817: dual_cert_enabled by jon_engineering at 1898765448

mike_support: override applied, customer able to login successfully. handing off to CS for renewal sentiment capture.

tara_cs: I'll run the 11:00 PT call and update CSM notes. setting renewal flag = "watch"; if no engagement in 48h escalate to AM.

jon_engineering: will plan to revert dual-cert after confirmation; will keep audit logs and revert at 2026-03-14T16:00Z if not needed.

tara_cs: perfect. capture feedback in CSM notes and add a short blurb to the "onboard-sso-rotations" playbook so we can shorten mean time to fix next time.

mike_support: thanks all — closing the loop here.
